newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka forex market steady on high liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka forex market steady on high liquidity.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee was steady against the dollar in early Friday trade, with the market well supplied with dollars and call money, dealers said.
At 0510 GMT the rupee was at its opening level of 58.48 to the dollar. The rupee closed at the same rate on Thursday.

"The begining of the first half of the year is usually a slack time. There are plenty of dollars to fill any import bills that may come along and the call money market is also well offered," said a foreign bank dealer.
Overnight call money was at 9.5 percent, after opening at 9.75 percent and rising to 10 percent when a big state bank borrowed, dealers said.
Dealers said the dollar rupee exchange rate should remain at current levels, unless there is an exceptionally large inward or outward remittance.
The Central Bank pushed down the exchange rate by three-quarter local cent, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.4768 and 59.6582.
